newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian 1996 budget revenue just above target.
newsitem.headline: Estonian 1996 budget revenue just above target.

text.p: Estonia's fInance ministry said on Wednesday that the 1996 state budget beat revenue collection targets by 0.4 percent.
The ministry said in a statement that state revenues reached 13.24 billion kroons instead of the planned 13.18 billion.
The major revenue earners were value added tax at 5.26 billion and personal income tax of 4.35 billion.
Excise duties brought 1.73 billion kroons into the state's coffers.
The final report on the state budget revenue and expenditure will be ready on June 1.
Estonia is one of the few nations which has laws saying that the government must have a balanced budget.
The 1997 budget amounts to 12.5 billion kroons, where receipts from VAT are forecast at 5.79 billion kroons and personal income tax of 2.25 billion kroons.
